ayahs.1: Have you considered the one who denies the Reckoning—as though no final audit awaits the cruelty hidden in boardrooms, homes, and hearts?
ayahs.2: That is the one who pushes away the orphan—treating vulnerable people as problems rather than trusts from Allah.
ayahs.3: And does not urge feeding the poor—indifferent to hunger while surplus exists.
ayahs.4: So woe to those who perform salah—
ayahs.5: yet are heedless in it—bodies present, minds elsewhere, treating prayer like a badge rather than standing before Allah;
ayahs.6: those who perform to be seen—curating religiosity for reputation;
ayahs.7: and refuse even small acts of neighbourly help—the everyday zakat of kindness they withhold.
